svg.title: Orange Blue
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Blue is painted ground; no transparency cut through the biomorphic orange figure. Silhouette hand traced from high-resolution Christie photograph. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of orange, blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.christies.com/en/lot/lot-6172963; record christies-6172963; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
